main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-done analysis section before Thursday: D finishing it tonight, or A, B and C splitting it up so D doesn't work.

A-B.evidence: A insists the work be divided among three (T10, T24); B repeatedly refuses ('I can't', T11) and says being a team doesn't mean A decides B has time (T21).

A-C.evidence: C says her section is behind and she can't do the analysis (T9); A acknowledges but still assigns all three to split it (T10, T24). C never agrees.

A-D.evidence: D repeatedly asks to finish tonight (T15, T17, T23, T25); A refuses each time: 'This is not your decision... The decision is made' (T24, T26).

B-C.evidence: Both say they lack capacity (T6, T9), but they never address each other and C says nothing after T9.

B-D.evidence: B asks why D's offer to do it tonight isn't the plan (T19); D says 'Agent B has a point' and repeats her offer (T23).

C-D.evidence: C only says she can't do the analysis (T9), which loosely fits D doing it herself, but C never comments on D's offer.
